# TAMS Gateway (`eyevinn-tams-gateway`)

Revolutionize your media management with TAMS Gateway—effortlessly store and index segmented media flows. Enhance efficiency and access powerfully with an integrated database and flexible service support.

[Service documentation](https://docs.osaas.io/osaas.wiki/Solution%3A-TAMS-storage.html) · [Source](https://github.com/Eyevinn/tams-gateway)

## Example

```terraform
resource "osc_instance" "example" {
  service_id = "eyevinn-tams-gateway"
  name       = "mygateway"

  parameters = {
    DbUrl              = "..."
    DbUsername         = "..."
    DbPassword         = "..."
    AwsAccessKeyId     = "..."
    AwsSecretAccessKey = "..."
    S3Bucket           = "..."
    # S3EndpointUrl      = "..."
    # AwsRegion          = "..."
    # CorsOrigin         = "..."
    # LogLevel           = "..."
  }
}
```

Commented lines are optional parameters. Values marked `"..."` need a real value. Outputs are `url`, `external_ip`, `external_port` and the raw `instance` document, see the `osc_instance` resource.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `DbUrl` | string | yes | The URL connection string for the CouchDB database that stores the TAMS segment index and metadata |
| `DbUsername` | string | yes | The username for authenticating with the CouchDB database |
| `DbPassword` | string | yes | The password for authenticating with the CouchDB database |
| `AwsAccessKeyId` | string | yes | The access key ID for authenticating with the S3-compatible storage service |
| `AwsSecretAccessKey` | string | yes | The secret access key for authenticating with the S3-compatible storage service |
| `S3Bucket` | string | yes | Configuration option for s3bucket |
| `S3EndpointUrl` | string | no | The endpoint URL for the S3-compatible storage service where media segments are stored |
| `AwsRegion` | string | no | Configuration option for awsregion |
| `CorsOrigin` | string | no | Configuration option for corsorigin |
| `LogLevel` | string | no | Logging or debugging configuration |

The instance `name` must match `^\w+$` and be unique per service within the workspace. OSC lowercases it and allows at most 20 characters.

Parameter values are strings; booleans take `"true"` or `"false"`. Reference an `osc_secret` as `osc_secret.<name>.ref` to keep a value out of the instance configuration. This page is generated from the OSC catalog; the provider validates against the live catalog when planning.
